notes: Managed launch starts the repo-local HTTP bridge sidecar that can publish into ROS2 when rclpy is available.
For the current Pi-hosted DOGZILLA direct bridge, transport.baseUrl points at http://10.0.4.32:8893.
For future Pi Docker ROS2 work, set transport.baseUrl back to the ROS2 sidecar port and switch target to ros2_real.
Choose Humble first because DOGZILLA S2 docs and Isaac Sim on Windows both document Humble support.
Jazzy is the newer ROS2 LTS and remains useful for playground work, but cross-distro comms are not guaranteed.
These are our intended bridge names, not verified Yahboom internal ROS2 interfaces.
The app publishes canonical plan JSON to /dogzilla/command_plan first, then the ROS bridge node owns any fanout to lower-level topics/services.
Edit transport, launch, and topic names freely once the real robot-side contract is bench-verified.
